datasets.name: job_execution_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as total_jobs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT workflow_name) as unique_workflows,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN job_run_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as jobs_with_status,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(job_run_status AS STRING), ''))) LIKE '%SUCCESS%' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(job_run_status AS STRING), ''))) LIKE '%COMPLETE%' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(job_run_status AS STRING), ''))) LIKE '%SUCCEED%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(job_run_status AS STRING), ''))) LIKE '%FAIL%' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(CAST(job_run_status AS STRING), ''))) LIKE '%ERROR%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failure_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mysql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mysql') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_redshift
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'redshift') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_pgsql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'postgres_sql') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_bigquery
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'bigquery') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mssql
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'mssql') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_run_status, start_time_job
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_snowflake
  WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, 'snowflake') AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
) combined_data

datasets.name: job_success_rate
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Data Completeness' as metric_name,
  CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 
      ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN job_run_status IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 1
      )
    ELSE 0 
  END as success_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT job_run_status, start_time_job FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mysql 
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'mysql' AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT job_run_status, start_time_job FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_redshift 
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'redshift' AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT job_run_status, start_time_job FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_pgsql 
  WHERE :param_database_type = 'postgres_sql' AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
 UNION ALL
  SELECT job_run_status, start_time_job FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_bigquery

 UNION ALL

  THEN "Failed"

datasets.name: job_execution_details
queryLines:
SELECT
  workflow_name,
  job_id,
  job_run_id,
  start_time_job,
  end_time_job,
  cluster_step_up_duration,
  job_run_status,
  job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status,
  total_job_run_duration,
  run_page,
  tasks,
  job_run_status_code,
  job_run_execution_duration,
  job_run_status_message,
  insert_time,
  database_type
FROM (
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_id, job_run_id, start_time_job, end_time_job, cluster_step_up_duration,
    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status, total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,
    'mysql' as database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mysql
  
  UNION ALL

    workflow_name, job_id, job_run_id, start_time_job, end_time_job, cluster_step_up_duration, 
    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status, total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,
    'redshift' as database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_redshift

    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status, total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,
    'pgsql' as database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_pgsql
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_id, job_run_id, start_time_job, end_time_job, cluster_step_up_duration, 
    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status,total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,
    'bigquery' as database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_bigquery
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_id, job_run_id, start_time_job, end_time_job, cluster_step_up_duration, 
    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status, total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,
    'mssql' as database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mssql
 
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    workflow_name, job_id, job_run_id, start_time_job, end_time_job, cluster_step_up_duration, 
    job_run_status, job_run_status.Job_Run_Status as status, total_job_run_duration, run_page, tasks, job_run_status_code, job_run_execution_duration, job_run_status_message, insert_time,

WHERE array_contains(:param_database_type, database_type) AND start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
ORDER BY start_time_job DESC

datasets.displayName: Job Run Analysis and Status Overview
queryLines:
WITH logs AS (
  -- Redshift logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'redshift' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_redshift
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- BigQuery logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'bigquery' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_bigquery
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- MS SQL Server logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'mssql' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mssql
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- MySQL logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'mysql' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_mysql
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Snowflake logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'snowflake' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_snowflake
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- PostgreSQL logs
  SELECT 
    * ,
    'pgsql' AS source_database_type
  FROM migration_catalog.logging.job_logs_pgsql
),

last_success_per_row AS (
  SELECT
    logs.workflow_name,
    logs.job_run_id,
    logs.source_database_type,
    success.end_time_job AS last_success_end_time,
    success.total_job_run_duration AS last_success_duration,
    CASE 
      WHEN logs.job_run_status.Job_Run_Status = 'Success_With_Failures' THEN 'Failed'
      -- WHEN logs.job_run_status.Job_Run_Status != 'success' THEN 'Failed'
      ELSE 'Success'
    END AS status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY logs.job_run_id 
      ORDER BY success.insert_time DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM logs
  LEFT JOIN logs AS success
    ON logs.workflow_name = success.workflow_name
    AND logs.source_database_type = success.source_database_type
    AND success.job_run_status.Job_Run_Status = 'success'
    AND success.insert_time < logs.insert_time
)

SELECT 
  l.*,
  s.last_success_end_time,
  s.last_success_duration,
  s.status
FROM logs l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT * 
  FROM last_success_per_row 
  WHERE rn = 1
) s
  ON l.job_run_id = s.job_run_id
  AND l.source_database_type = s.source_database_type
WHERE s.status = 'Failed'
  AND l.start_time_job BETWEEN :param_start_date AND :param_end_date
  AND array_contains(:param_database_type, l.source_database_type)
ORDER BY l.insert_time DESC, l.source_database_type, l.workflow_name;
